newsitem.title: UK: UK's Harlow Butler in India forex joint venture.
newsitem.headline: UK's Harlow Butler in India forex joint venture.

text.p: Harlow Butler said in a statement that it is to take a majority stake in a new joint venture with Merwanjee Bomanjee Dalal, to be called Merwanjee Forex Private Ltd, based in Bombay.

"In future with the likelihood of full convertibility of the rupee on the capital account, we expect to be in a strong position to provide banks in India with direct access to international counterparties," said Peter Goddard, deputy chief executive of Harlow Butler.
Harlow Butler is a unit of United News & Media Plc and Merwanjee Bomanjee Dalal is an Indian broker and foreign exchange trader. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
